blocked_input.required_role: relative inflation pressure versus USD for ALIGNED/MIXED/CONTRADICTORY classification
blocked_input.reason: The canonical USD CPI series can be revised through seasonal adjustment. Current revised history cannot be used as historical first-release information without look-ahead leakage.

prohibited_actions: Do not run or interpret conditional performance using current revised USD CPI history.
Do not substitute observation dates for release dates.
Do not change the predeclared state definitions or gates to bypass the blocker.
Do not drop EUR or any other currency.
Do not change alpha, training window, thresholds, or model specification from PR #122.
reopen_conditions: USD inflation full-window PIT is certified with exact first-release availability semantics compatible with the canonical series contract.
The certified input is available deterministically to the validation runner.
